decisions.reason: As a large established German machinery firm, management is likely to tolerate early uncertainty for a complementary 2023 launch, but the weaker website prominence suggests somewhat lower internal aspirations and a higher chance of reallocation if results disappoint.

Its dedicated product page indicates strategic commitment, and with organisational slack the firm would likely keep this 2023 printer on the market while learning about demand rather than terminate it quickly.

This product also appears to have received clear market support through a dedicated page, so under behavioral decision-making a large incumbent would usually continue it unless early feedback falls clearly below aspirations.
